subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: The Access Control plugin manages access to resources within a Lutece application by defining access rules and strategies. It provides an administration interface that allows users to configure access rules and apply them to various system resources.

subsection.name: Usage
subsection.p: Once the plugin is installed and activated, the Lutece administration panel offers an interface to:

ol.li: Create access rules (e.g., restrict access by user role).
Assign these rules to specific resources (pages, actions, APIs).
View and modify existing access controls.
